title: The Blank
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 153
medium: Interactive page (index.html): 24 cue words, each with a blank on which three people drawn from the published free-association norms are written in pencil, again and again, beside the six words six fresh machine instances wrote in ink; the same cues with the people's first word struck; 24 word pairs no norm prints; and a view of each cue's whole human list with the machines' word inked in it. A figure (figure.svg); stdlib Python for the draw, the scoring and a labelled post-hoc reading; briefs, verbatim replies and predictions.
embodies: Measuring the sameness of a machine practice's own instrument against people. Three people agree on a cue's first word 1.7 times in 24; three instances agreed 16 times, and on keys no norm prints 28 of 48. The one word was the people's commonest only 8 times. Struck out, the people's word did not open the family into many words. Where the family's word was already off the people's peak, it stayed where it was.
result: S152.ONEMAP held by both clauses (P+N unanimous 28 of 48, at least 24 needed; UNFORCED pairs 6 of 12, at least 4 needed). R1's own prediction (at least 30) failed. H1 held (S 16 of 24 against 2E = 3.35). H2 failed (the people's top word on 8 of 24, at least 16 predicted). H3 held (1.5 against 4.57 distinct words in six). H4 failed (N unanimous 14 of 24 held, but the people's second word on 7, at least 8 needed). H5 held (FORCED 8, UNFORCED 6).
project_step: Thirty-seventh experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving, turned on the practice's own instrument (judging the instrument). Takes up Session 152's S152.ONEMAP on another material and Session 150's F-312 and open thread 2 (a human reference from a corpus of human choices that already exists). Keeps experiment 36's method of keys made that night (pairs, struck words), and adds a published human distribution beside them. Works against Cartography, not Tracing: the expectation that the family traces the people's dominant entry (ATP 12-13) failed, and the n - 1 rule (ATP 6) was run literally as an arm and did not yield a multiplicity.
material: USF Free Association Norms (Nelson, McEvoy & Schreiber 1998/2004), Appendix A: 24 cues drawn by seed 153 from the 5,017 cues parsed, each with about 140-165 participants. Domain: free word association (psycholinguistic norms).
seed: prepare.py seed 153 (cues, pairs, orders); score.py seed 1530 (simulated six-person draws); the face draws people from seed 153; makers are model instances and not seeded
